title: A phase's status is derived, so a finished phase stops holding the gate
description: F466, operator decision 2026-09-24: derived status with recorded sign-off; sign-off due does not hold the gate.
desiredOutcome: a phase whose tasks are all terminal and whose sign-off is recorded (and, with a branch, merged) reads done everywhere; one only awaiting sign-off reads 'sign-off due' and no longer holds the plan gate in deny; sign-off is recorded by a verb

tasks.title: The derived phase status, named once beside effective_bug_status
tasks.description: effective_phase_status, signoff_recorded, signoff_due and phase_running: the one answer every reader of a phase's status will ask.
